'''2008 Worlds Day 2 David McCune DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Inventory McClain; sheet David McCune. Title Loses to WYS.

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
